customer: hey so im moving for a new job and want to sell my electric car before i go. problem is the odometer screen got replaced last year and now the miles it shows are way off from what the car actualy has. does that mess up selling it to you?
agent: Congratulations on the new job! You can still sell it. Just let us know the odometer was replaced when you request your offer, and at the appointment you'll mark 'not actual mileage' on the odometer statement, form NW-ODO-1. Cars marked 'not actual mileage' get a reduced offer, but if you know the true mileage, bring records that show it, such as service invoices.
